events.title: Celebrate Diwali: Traditional Stories, Music and Dance

cases.refreshed: Come join us to celebrate the Festival of Lights—Diwali! Immerse your family in an interactive Indian classical dance and storytelling program that brings the traditions, stories and spirit of Diwali to life through movement, music and audience participation. Diwali tales brought to life through expressive Indian classical movement, music and rhythms and concludes with a joyful group dance! This vibrant event welcomes families experiencing Indian dance and Diwali for the first time while offering South Asian families a wonderful opportunity to see their heritage represented and celebrated in their local library. Open to all backgrounds, this colorful, musical program guarantees fun for everyone whether you are deeply familiar with Indian culture or discovering it for the very first time! This program is generously sponsored by the SJPL Foundation's Pat Dando Endowment Fund and the Friends of the Almaden Branch Library.

cases.refreshed: Do you want to build your English-language skills and your confidence? The English Language Learner (ELL) Beginning English program is a welcoming and respectful environment for adult learners to begin their English language journey. Participants will have the opportunity to learn & develop their speaking, listening, reading and writing skills. Suggested for beginner English language learners. The ELL Beginning English program meets weekly at the library in the library's Community Room with a trained facilitator. Free. No Registration required. Vineland's English Learning series: ELL Beginning English: The Basics - A beginner program for learners with limited English skills; approximately levels 0-2; ELL Intermediate English: Grammar and Vocabulary Club - An intermediate program for learners that know some English but want to learn more complex English; approximately levels 2-3; ELL Advanced English: Conversation Club - An advanced program for learners to practice speaking and listening while also learning about American culture and idioms; approximately levels 3-4; ELL Writing Club: A program where high beginners to advanced level English language learners can learn and practice their English writing skills; approximately levels 2-4; ELL Reading & Speaking: A program where high beginners to advanced level English language learners can read aloud and practice their pronunciation; approximately levels 2-4.
